description:
Extend Renderer.walk_vnode/2 to resolve slot vnodes at render time.

## Changes

**lib/filament/renderer.ex** — add walk_vnode heads:
```elixir
def walk_vnode({:slot, _name, [], nil}, _ctx),
  do: {:fragment, []}

def walk_vnode({:slot, _name, [], default_mod}, ctx) when not is_nil(default_mod),
  do: walk_vnode({:component, default_mod, %{}, nil}, ctx)

def walk_vnode({:slot, _name, entries, _default}, ctx) do
  children =
    Enum.flat_map(entries, fn %Filament.Slot.Entry{render_fn: f} ->
      [walk_child(f.(), ctx)]
    end)
  {:fragment, children}
end
```

Slot content is rendered in the **provider's** fiber context. Each `{:component, ...}` inside a slot gets its own child fiber via the existing `render_component_child/3` machinery — no special casing needed.

## Acceptance
- Slot content components receive proper child fiber identity; hooks survive re-renders
- Empty optional slot with no default renders nothing (empty fragment)
- Empty optional slot with default renders the default component
- Filled slot renders caller-supplied content in the provider's fiber tree
title: Renderer: resolve and walk {:slot, ...} vnodes
